segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: Well, good morning, everyone, it's good to see you all here.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: Welcome to Smith House.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: Smith House as you may or may not know is one of the oldest residential colleges of the university.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: As you can see, the building you're in now which contains this main lounge, the dining room, the recreation room, the kitchen and the offices was part of the original old house, built in the 1840s to be used by the family of George Smith.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: That's of course how the house and college got their names.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: The original house was converted into, a residential college for the university in 1940 and since then has continued to be added on to and modernised.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: You'll notice when you receive your room allocation in a few minutes that your room number either begins with the letter N, S, or W like this one here.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: The first letter refers to the three wings of the college which come away from this main building.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: Of course the letters represent the three directions - in this case - north, south and west.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: Each wing has two floors, and so the next number you see is either one, or in this case two, and this indicates which floor your room is on.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: The number after that is your individual room number.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: So it's quite simple to find any room by going to the right wing, then floor, and then room number.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: You'll also notice, when you receive your orientation pack shortly, that there are two keys.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: One is the key to your room and only you have that key - and the other is a key to the front door which you've just come through here from the street.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: This door is closed and locked at 8 pm every night and opened again at 7 am.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: You'll need your key if you're coming back to the college between those times.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: We ask all students to always enter and leave the college through the front door.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: You will notice at the end of each corridor that there is another door but these are fire doors and are kept locked from the outside.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: They should only be opened from the inside in case of emergency.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: In your fees you've paid a laundry fee which covers the cleaning of bed linen and towels.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: All bed linen and towels are clearly embossed with the name Smith House so it's easily identifiable.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: If you want your other laundry to be done by the college this can be arranged for a small extra fee.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: There are only a few rules here at Smith House and we have these rules so that we can all live comfortably together.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: The most important rule is that there must be no noise after 9 pm.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: There is also no smoking in the rooms or anywhere inside the college but smoking is permitted on the balconies.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: Q]g All meals are served in the dining room.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: Meal times are listed in your orientation pack.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: Please read these carefully as meal times cannot be changed and if you arrive late I'm sorry to say you'll just go hungry.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: If you're unsure about things, each floor has an elected 'floor senior' who is usually a student in their third or fourth year of study who's been at Smith House for a while.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: The floor seniors will introduce themselves later today and answer any questions you have.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: But for now I'm going to hand you over to Marney who is going to give you the orientation packs and keys.

segments.speaker: COLLEGE PRESIDENT
segments.en: Thanks Marney.
